name: Safe Rollback
description: Name the known-good state, show the rollback target, avoid throwing away data, and verify after the rollback.

permissionsRequired.reason: Inspect the running release on a configured server alias before switching back.
Read the local release or compose definition for the known-good target.
Roll back a local process or compose service.
See whether the worktree is the rollback target.

validation.rule: A known-good target was named from git history, a release id, or the running version before the rollback, and service health was checked afterward.
